material.$description: Two kinds of glass, both for controls only, never content. 'glass' is a control on a page. 'glass-on-art' is a control floating on artwork (a header illustration, a race lane). Life Hub uses glass for both; After Graduation keeps page controls solid and uses glass only over artwork.

blur-on-art.$description: Blur behind a control that floats on artwork.

glass.$description: Fill for glass controls and cards.

glass-on-art.$description: Fill for a control floating on artwork, so the art shows through.

glass-on-art-selected.$description: Selected control on artwork. Same as glass on hover.

glass-on-art.$description: Light edge around a control on artwork.

glass.$description: Inner light along the edges of a glass surface.
